data.description: Extend the fallback model definitions to define a per model context size. If the context goes above that size then fall through to the next model. This will enable us to create a more efficient use of rate limited models, such as MinutoAI. Only allow queries that are under the per minute token limit to reach the model.
data.title: Per model context size

data.author: Map
